notes: Voice packs for the fully audio-guided timer (see specs/22-voice-guidance.md). A voice pack is FLAVOR only — it changes the coach's persona/tone/cadence, NOT what gets spoken (the announce contract is identical everywhere). Packs are TTS-provider-agnostic: tts_hints are advisory (rate/pitch/style) and the app maps them to whatever voice engine it uses. ACCESSIBILITY: 'coach' is the neutral default and the user can always override any campaign's pack back to 'coach' (or mute). Intelligibility and SAFETY come first — safety cues and counts are ALWAYS spoken plainly and clearly regardless of persona; flavor never obscures the instruction.

rules.flavor_only: A pack may change greeting/hype/transition phrasing and vocal tone. It must NOT change the movement name, the count, or any safety cue wording — those stay literal and clear.
rules.user_override: Users can set any campaign to the neutral 'coach' pack, pick a different pack, or mute voice entirely.
rules.fallback: If a campaign's assigned pack is unavailable in the current TTS engine/language, fall back to 'coach'.
rules.language: Packs are persona/tone definitions; localization uses the same pack ids with language-specific voices.

tts_hint_fields.rate: slow | measured | normal | brisk | fast (advisory speaking rate)
tts_hint_fields.style: free-text persona style hint for the voice engine
